newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's MetroGas to issue $62.5 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's MetroGas to issue $62.5 mln bond.

text.p: Argentina's largest gas distributor, MetroGas, said Tuesday it will issue $62.5 million in variable rate four-year bonds.
The issue was approved Tuesday by the company's directors. No date for the placement was given. British Gas PLC is the operator of MetroGas.

Interest on the bond will be LIBOR plus 138 basis points in the first year, LIBOR plus 188 basis point in the second, LIBOR plus 213 basis points in the third year and LIBOR plus 238 basis points in the last year of the life of the bond.

The income from the bond will be used to refinance short-term bank debt, MetroGas said in a statement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange. The issue is part of the company's $350 million global bond program.
